what: Narrow vertical columns stand in a row and only the first column is open wide. The hovered column widens from 14.0625vw → 29.6875vw in .3s ease-in-out while the others narrow, and the image and text inside the widened column switch on .2s late over .3s. When the pointer leaves the row it returns to the first column — a process chart for design and work stages. On touch screens the tapped column opens

options.[data-fx-part=reveal]: Inner part visible only when expanded (image, text)
options.w · open-w: Narrow and wide column widths (css length), default 14.0625vw · 29.6875vw
